title: octogee-gateway values
description: Defense-in-depth schema for the per-gateway chart. Catches shape errors (wrong type, missing required key, unknown profile) BEFORE template logic runs. Platform secrets are intentionally absent from the gatewayEdge values surface.

gatewayId.description: Bare logical gateway identity (e.g. `default`, `bender`). Tenant-scoped: names the K8s auth-token/model-key secrets, the gateway KSA, and the GATEWAY_ID pod env. Also the /g/<id>/* public path segment.

revisionId.description: Disposable revision instance id ({gatewayId}-r{n}). Every per-instance resource NAME (Deployment, Services, PDB, NetworkPolicies) and the gateway-instance selector derive from it. Empty defaults to gatewayId (legacy single-revision render).

ownerUid.description: Dedicated builder/operator owner UID rendered into immutable pod metadata.

builderSlug.description: Dedicated builder/operator owner slug. Empty on shared gateways; when set, non-shared gateways restore openclaw.json from the builder's system_config repo.

profile.description: Legacy image/capability profile. Empty + 'standard' are equivalent standard image behavior; 'operator' selects the operator image. New callers should set gatewayClass + imageProfile.

gatewayClass.description: Product/security class. Empty derives from legacy profile. shared=multi-builder exec-off, builder=one-builder exec-on with shell feature gate, operator=same runtime trust boundary plus operator image/BYO GCP tooling.

imageProfile.description: Installed image/tooling profile. Empty derives from gatewayClass/legacy profile.

replicas.description: Replica count for the gateway Deployment. 0 = paused (Cowboy sets this for desiredStatus=paused); 1 = running. HPA / multi-replica is GATEWAY-PLATFORM-SPEC §Phase 6, out of scope here.

sizingTier.description: Per-pod sizing tier. Empty = fall back to classDefaults[gatewayClass], then profileDefaults[imageProfile].

classDefaults.description: Gateway class → default tier mapping. Used when sizingTier is unset.

profileDefaults.description: Legacy image-profile → default tier mapping. Used when sizingTier is unset and classDefaults is absent. `standard` is required — the effectiveTier helper falls back to it as the last-resort default.

tiers.description: Tier preset matrix — resources + Node runtime tuning per tier. Mirrored in shared/types/sizing.ts. All tier keys are required so a typo or trim doesn't leave effectiveTier pointing at a missing preset.

platformMetadataEgress.description: Platform-builder D7 carve-out: open egress to the GKE metadata server (169.254.169.254) for this gateway's read-only WI GSA. Default off; the fleet-wide gateway-egress policy blocks metadata for every other gateway.

kubeApiServerEgressCidrs.description: Operator gateway TokenReview carve-out: explicit Kubernetes API server endpoint /32 CIDR(s) from the default/kubernetes EndpointSlice. Default empty/off.
